title: FastLongSpeech: Enhancing Large Speech-Language Models for Efficient Long-Speech Processing

layout.note: One light-grey rounded canvas split by a thin vertical line. The left panel (about 60% of the width) is a bottom-up model stack with a legend at the top left, text-token boxes above and below the model box, and a dotted wedge from the Extractor to an enlarged group (six frames, Iterative Fusion, CTC Decoder, two condensed frames) at the lower middle. The right panel has a title and a bottom-up stack of three frame rows joined by cyan arrows, with numbers between and under the frames.

lesson: Explain a compression step by redrawing the same row of frames after each iteration, with grouped frames in dotted span boxes and the deciding numbers written between and under the frames; tie that detail panel to the architecture with a dotted wedge from the module.
